title: docs(census): state the no-changeset-for-tooling ruling in the census header (objectui#9795)
body:
Fixes #9795

Clause-②: no

Session: `session_01QVJUngS9FKfuyQ9NFR2Nbn` · base ref `0c2eb5eee029ecbc0c7d818d4bf49d3a370acea5`

Ruling batch 162 item 3 (comment 5729876263, director seat summon 24, maintainer agreed 2026-09-18T12:18Z) settles a question this repository had answered twice in opposite directions about forty minutes apart. Its operative clause, quoted verbatim from that comment:

> a change to `scripts/changeset-polarity-census.mjs` or any other tooling the presence instrument says owes no changeset gets none; the intent is recorded in the PR body; the instrument's own header states this, next to its false-positive sources; `.changeset/9754-polarity-clause-scope.md` is measured — if it contributes to the census it is removed in the next tooling PR

## What landed

One comment-only hunk in `scripts/changeset-polarity-census.mjs`: a header section titled `A change to THIS instrument carries no changeset (objectui#9795)`, placed immediately after the list of that instrument's false-positive sources and immediately before its `Controls` section — beside that list, as the clause requires, and ⛔ not in a new document and ⛔ not as one more item inside the list (it is not a precision source; it is the rule that keeps one off the list). It states three things:

1. the rule and its provenance, and why it is paid for here: the corpus IS `.changeset/`, so a changeset written about this script becomes one of this script's own inputs on the very next run, and keeping the list honest about that would take a self-exclusion — one more precision source, bought for a release note that declares nothing;
2. that the rule is CONDITIONAL on `scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` and is ⛔ NOT a blanket exemption for `scripts/` — that instrument derives its guarded surface from the release configuration rather than a hand-written list, so if it ever says a tooling diff owes a declaration, that diff owes one;
3. that the ruling's other half was conditional on a measurement, with a pointer to where the reading lives rather than the reading itself (commandment #9).

No executable line moves. Re-running `pnpm census:changeset-polarity` after the edit reproduces the pre-edit readings exactly — same entries scanned, same matched assertions across the same number of entries, same candidate contradictions, controls PASS, exit 0.

## This PR's own intent — obligation 2

This is itself a tooling change, so it is the rule's own first test case: **it declares no changeset.** The intent is recorded here, in this body, which is where the ruling puts it.

Fresh reading of the authority on this branch (⛔ not transcribed from the card):

```
$ node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs                                   # exit 0
Compared the working tree with 0c2eb5eee (merge-base with origin/main): 1 file(s)
changed, 0 of them published source of a package the release covers, 0 of them a
manifest whose published contract moved, 0 under a package changesets ignores,
0 changeset(s) added.
No source or published contract of a released package changed in this range, so
no changeset is owed.
```

Taken twice, before and after the commit, with the same verdict. If a gate ever demands a changeset for this diff, that contradiction is a finding to report, ⛔ not a reason to write one.

## The measurement — obligation 3, and it is what decides the obligation

Ref: `0c2eb5eee029ecbc0c7d818d4bf49d3a370acea5` (this branch's base — `origin/main` at fetch time). Instrument: the census itself, imported rather than re-implemented, so the reading is the instrument's own attribution of matched assertions to an entry name.

| reading | value |
| --- | --- |
| the instrument's own controls | all PASS — corpus lit/absent, member lit/absent, resolution lit/absent — so its zeros are readings |
| corpus totals, this run | entries scanned 1787; matched assertions 236 across 191 entries; candidate contradictions 42 across 23 entries |
| **`.changeset/9754-polarity-clause-scope.md` — matched assertions** | **0** |
| same entry — quoted / superseded / candidate contradictions | 0 / 0 / 0 |

Controls, because a zero without one is not a reading:

- **the entry was in the corpus this run read** — yes; the census's own `readCorpus` returned it.
- **its text reached the segmenter** — yes: it segmented into 3 sentences, and a token unique to it, `census:changeset-polarity`, is present in one of them. So this is not a file-never-opened zero. One of its sentences does name a schema symbol (`ObjectKanbanSchema`); none carries a present-tense declaration verb, so none reaches the population predicate — which is exactly why it contributes nothing.
- **the same reading can be non-zero at the same granularity** — yes: in the same run, other entries read 4, 4 and 3 matched assertions.
- **ABLATION — the decisive control.** The census was re-run over a byte-identical COPY of the corpus, held outside the repository, in which one sentence was appended to that same file:

```
The interface `ObjectKanbanSchema` declares `zzProbeKeyZZ` today.
```

  The same probe then attributed **1 matched assertion and 1 candidate contradiction to that exact entry name**, and the corpus totals moved 236 → 237 matched, 191 → 192 entries, 42 → 43 contradictions. ⇒ the zero is a property of that file's TEXT, ⛔ not of the instrument's ability to attribute a reading to that filename. The repository's own entry was never touched: grep for the injected token in the tracked file returns zero hits, and the working tree stayed clean.

⇒ **The condition is FALSE, so the conditional does not fire: `.changeset/9754-polarity-clause-scope.md` is NOT removed by this PR and is left exactly as it stands.** The ruling conditions the removal on the measurement, and this PR is the "next tooling PR" the clause names, so the question is answered rather than deferred.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么。** 只改一个文件、只改注释:给 `scripts/changeset-polarity-census.mjs` 的文件头加了一节,把「改这把仪器不写 changeset」这条裁决写进代码里,紧挨着它原有的「假阳源清单」。没有任何可执行代码变动,本 PR 自己也**没有**写 changeset —— 它就是这条规则的第一个用例。

**为什么改。** 这个问题此前被两个 PR 用相反的答案各答了一次(相隔约四十分钟),裁决要的是「答一次」:写在卡上,下一个 dev 还得翻卡;写在仪器自己的头部,他读代码时就看到了。

**风险与代价(含回滚)。** 风险主要是一条:规则被读成「`scripts/` 一律免写 changeset」。已在正文里挡住 —— 明写权威是 `check-changeset-presence.mjs`,它按发版配置推导受管面,它说欠就是欠。代价是文件头又长了一节。回滚成本为零:`git revert` 一个纯注释 commit,不影响任何行为;另外没有任何门禁断言这一节存在,所以它若被后人删掉,不会有东西变红(这一点也记在下面的 Acceptance notes 里)。

**席位意见。**

**你要做的。** 只需确认两件事:① 这条规则的措辞是否就是您 2026-09-18 同意的那一条;② `.changeset/9754-polarity-clause-scope.md` 实测对 census 贡献 0 条 matched assertion(带消融对照),因此按裁决**不删**——这个读数是否被接受。其余无需动作。

## Gates — hand-derived, because `dispatch-gates.mjs` refuses for this repo

That script derives its families from the objectstack tree it runs in and says so outright, so this list was hand-derived from this repository's own `package.json` scripts and the workflow files enumerated from `origin/main` (`git ls-tree`, 39 files, equal to the working-tree count — the enumeration control passed). Exit codes were captured to disk before any pipe.

| gate | exit | reading |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` (twice: working tree, then post-commit) | 0, 0 | nothing owed — quoted above |
| `pnpm exec vitest run scripts/__tests__/changeset-polarity-census.test.ts` | 0 | `Test Files 1 passed (1)` · `Tests 71 passed (71)` — the whole file, ⛔ no `-t` regex, so nothing could be silently deselected |
| `pnpm type-check:scripts` (the REAL type-check, ⛔ not the coverage test) | 0 | `tsc -p tsconfig.scripts.json` clean; `--listFiles` proves the edited file is in that program |
| `pnpm type-check:coverage` | 0 | 45/46 via `type-check`, 43/43 test projects |
| `pnpm lint:root` — the lane that covers `scripts/` | 0 | 384 files linted (population read from eslint's own config via `--format json`), 0 errors, 32 pre-existing warnings, **0 / 0 on the edited file**; this is the whole lane, ⛔ not a narrowing |
| `pnpm lint:coverage` · `pnpm check:lint-rule-coverage` | 0, 0 | 46/46 packages linted |
| `pnpm check:control-bytes` | 0 | 8116 tracked text files scanned |
| `pnpm check:entry-guard` | 0 | 105 `scripts/` files; no hand-typed guard |
| `pnpm check:new-line-citations` | 0 | 0 new cross-file line citations |
| `pnpm check:comment-mask-corpus` | 0 | 5186 files; 1 pre-existing disagreement, within the held-open residue |
| `pnpm check:changeset-claims` | 0 | ⚠️ its own words: this change adds and modifies NO changeset, so that run **measured nothing** of its class |
| `pnpm check:pending-changeset-literals` | 0 | no test source names a pending changeset |
| `pnpm check:upstream-port-parity` | 0 | 11 ported files still match their pins |
| `node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test scripts/changeset-polarity-census.mjs` | 0 | NOT GOVERNED — ordinary review and merge-queue route |
| `pnpm census:changeset-polarity` (after the edit) | 0 | controls PASS; readings identical to the pre-edit run |

NOT MEASURED locally, and named rather than implied: the full `pnpm test` suite and the per-package `turbo run lint` / `turbo run type-check` lanes. This diff touches no package source, and those lanes are CI's run.

## Acceptance notes

- **The other entries written for changes to this same instrument read zero too.** The corpus holds five more entries authored for changes to this script — `9727-changeset-polarity-instrument-rebuild.md`, `9754-slice-2-window-pairing.md`, `9767-census-schema-absent-split.md`, `9832-census-never-annotation-polarity.md`, `9870-census-superseded-readings-table.md`. Measured with the same probe at the same ref: each contributes 0 matched assertions, 0 quoted, 0 superseded, 0 candidate contradictions, although three of them do carry a present-tense declaration verb somewhere. ⇒ the self-reference the card feared is real in principle and unrealised by every entry in this family today. Noted, ⛔ not filed: there is nothing to remove and nothing to repair, and the ruling's conditional named one file.
- **Nothing re-derives the header statement.** No gate and no pin asserts that this section exists or that its wording is the ruled one; the presence instrument enforces the rule only in the direction of DEMANDING a changeset, never in the direction of forbidding one. Said here per commandment #9 rather than left to read as enforced. A pin would sit outside this PR's declared file surface, so it was ⛔ not added. Noted, ⛔ not filed — successor: whoever next edits this header (the CENSUS chain the card fences serially).
- **The issue's premises were checked against `origin/main`, ⛔ not trusted.** The self-reference premise is confirmed by reading the instrument: its corpus reader takes every `.changeset/*.md` except `README.md`, and its default corpus directory is the repository's `.changeset`, so a changeset about the instrument is one of its inputs. The presence instrument's verdict was re-run rather than transcribed. The two opposite precedents were read as history only and ⛔ not re-argued.
